title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**What you'll bring:**

**Required**

* 3–7+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or AI Engineer (flexible based on seniority).
* Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-driven applications in production contexts.
* Hands-on work with libraries/frameworks such as LangChain, OpenAI/MCP, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration tools.
* Proficiency with Python (or Typescript/Node) and modern development workflows.
* Experience integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, vector databases, and retrieval systems.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization (Docker), cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure), and DevOps fundamentals.
* Familiarity with automated testing approaches for LLM applications (unit tests, scenario testing, eval harnesses).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to design resilient systems in ambiguous environments.

**Preferred**

* Experience deploying and scaling MCP servers, custom toolchains, or enterprise agent frameworks.
* Prior work building tools or automations for Sales, Marketing, or RevOps teams (e.g., CRM-integrated apps, quoting tools, outbound tooling, marketing analytics or experimentation platforms).
* Background or project experience in the building industry (construction, materials distribution, building automation, supply chain, procurement) or other B2B industry.
* Experience with workflow engines (Airflow, Prefect, etc) and/or MLOps (Mlflow, Flyte, etc) and event-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with vector and search/retrieval systems.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, or RLHF-style evaluation frameworks.

  
  

**What you'll do:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer, AI to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents that augment workflows across our organization. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with agentic frameworks, MCP servers, LLM orchestration libraries, and robust testing/monitoring practices. This role blends software engineering excellence with applied machine learning and offers the opportunity to push the boundaries of intelligent automation in real business environments.

**Responsibilities**

**AI Agent Development & Deployment**

* Architect, build, and optimize AI agents using modern agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalents).
* Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, custom tools, and integrations to enable secure and scalable agent capabilities.
* Design agentic workflows that can operate autonomously, perform multi-step reasoning, and interact with structured/unstructured data sources.
* Package and deploy agents into production environments with attention to reliability, observability, and performance.

**Sales & Marketing Agent Use Cases**

* Build agents that support Sales Representatives, such as:
* Lead and account research, enrichment, and prioritization.
* Drafting and personalizing outbound emails and sequences.
* Summarizing calls, meetings, and account activity to drive next-best actions.
* Integrating with CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach) to automate data entry and insight surfacing.
* Generating detailed bills of materials (BOMs), estimates, and quotes from drawings, specs, takeoffs, or CRM/opportunity data, including price checks, margin validation, and versioning.
* Build agents that support Marketing, such as:
* Generating and localizing content for campaigns, landing pages, and nurture programs.
* Assisting with audience segmentation, experimentation, and performance analysis.
* Powering internal “marketing copilots” that answer questions from campaign, web, and analytics data.
* Partner with the business to identify high-ROI workflows for automation and to measure the impact of deployed agents on pipeline, conversion, quoting speed/accuracy, and engagement metrics.

**Systems Engineering & Tooling**

* Develop internal libraries, reusable modules, and standardized patterns for building agentic applications.
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise APIs, cloud services, databases, pricing/catalog systems, and operational infrastructure.
* Build CI/CD pipelines for both model-related code and agent-specific behavior, including automated testing, evaluation harnesses, and regression detection for LLM-powered systems.

**Testing, Evaluation & Monitoring**

* Create frameworks for continuous evaluation of agents, including prompt tests, scenario simulations, and safety/robustness checks.
* Monitor agent performance in production, diagnose failures, and iterate quickly on improvements.
* Implement logging, analytics, and feedback loops to guide ongoing training or refinement—especially for critical revenue and quoting workflows.

**Collaboration & Strategy**

* Work closely with product, engineering, Sales, Marketing, and domain experts to translate business processes into agentic flows.
* Partner with stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and design AI-powered operational solutions.
* Contribute to internal documentation, best practices, and AI engineering guidelines.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Machine Learning Research Engineer I
description:
**Member of Technical Staff - Machine Learning Research Engineer I**  
  
San Francisco Bay Area | Bellevue, Washington
  
  
**About AIVista**  
  
NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, is based in Silicon Valley. We develop AI products for enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We work with NTT DATA Inc., NTT DATA Japan, and NTT DOCOMO to deploy systems for NTT clients. Our clients combine AIVista's product AI expertise with NTT DATA's industry knowledge and systems-integration experience.  
  
**The Role**  
  
The Machine Learning Research Engineer works closely with AIVista scientists to turn promising research into dependable capabilities for enterprise use. You will develop a deep understanding of each method, its assumptions, supporting evidence, and known limitations, then focus on the work required to make it reproducible, robust, scalable, and maintainable.  
  
You will test how methods behave across realistic workloads, varied domains and data, difficult edge cases, and operational constraints; improve their reliability and efficiency; and integrate them into product capabilities with the traceability, controls, and review boundaries required in regulated industries. This work spans reinforcement learning, simulation environments, formal methods, autoformalization, and AIVista's data, rule, action, and process ontologies.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with scientists to understand each method's assumptions, supporting evidence, known failure modes, and acceptance criteria for broader use.
* Reproduce research results across independent runs and settings, characterize sources of variance, and identify behavior that depends on a narrow dataset, model version, configuration, or operating condition.
* Refactor and extend research prototypes without changing their scientific meaning; make tradeoffs explicit and validate each material change against agreed baselines.
* Design stress tests, adversarial cases, counterfactual scenarios, rare events, and out-of-distribution evaluations that expose brittle behavior before product use.
* Scale methods from research-sized examples to realistic workflow length, data volume, concurrency, and domain variation while controlling latency and cost.
* Improve reliability, calibration, constraint adherence, recovery behavior, and consistency, and determine whether measured gains generalize beyond the original research cases.
* Advance synthetic environments, workflow simulations, and agent evaluations from research prototypes into stable, versioned assets that represent exceptions, human review, governed actions, and external-system behavior.
* Harden autoformalization and ontology-backed methods so source traceability, rule and process semantics, validation evidence, and governed actions remain correct as content and scale change.
* Preserve independent checks and acceptance evidence as models, code, data, ontologies, and process definitions evolve.
* Feed findings back to Science, including failures that require changes to the problem formulation, learning method, reward or constraint design, formalization approach, or evaluation strategy.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to define operating limits, monitoring, regression tests, release criteria, rollback plans, and ownership for capabilities moving into production.
* Build the durable software and automation required for reproducible experimentation, repeated evaluation, efficient scaling, and safe product integration, and maintain clear documentation for future contributors.

**Qualifications**  
  
**Basic**

* Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, software engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience taking machine-learning or research prototypes toward reliable, sustained use at realistic scale.

* Demonstrated experience improving the reproducibility, robustness, scalability, or operating efficiency of a research capability, supported by clear measurements and failure analysis.
* Strong software-engineering judgment, including the ability to restructure prototypes, isolate assumptions, design effective tests, diagnose performance and reliability problems, and leave maintainable code and documentation.
* Working knowledge of machine learning, statistical evaluation, experimental design, and failure analysis, with the ability to implement methods from papers and reason about how engineering changes affect the method.
* Experience evaluating behavior across changing data, model versions, workloads, and operating conditions rather than relying on a single benchmark result.
* Ability to collaborate closely with scientists, engineers, product teams, and domain experts to move research capabilities toward reliable use in regulated environments.

**Preferred**

* Experience hardening reinforcement-learning environments, agent systems, workflow simulations, digital twins, or other sequential-decision methods for use beyond research demonstrations.
* Experience evaluating long-horizon agents, verifier-guided methods, or reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards under adversarial, rare, or changing conditions.
* Experience scaling ontology-backed, knowledge-graph, rule, process, or provenance-aware methods while preserving semantic correctness and source traceability.
* Experience taking formal specifications, autoformalization, program analysis, or verification methods from research prototypes into repeatable software-development workflows.

**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?**

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

We are seeking an exceptional AI Scientist/Engineer to bridge two cutting-edge domains in medical AI: **Oncology Foundation Models** and **Agentic Systems**. In this role, you will design and train domain-specific foundation models on complex, multimodal cancer datasets (genomics, histopathology, longitudinal EHRs, and clinical imaging) while simultaneously building agentic workflows that orchestrate these models.

By integrating foundation models with agentic frameworks, you will help create intelligent clinical tools capable of dynamic reasoning, multi-step evidence synthesis, and complex decision support in oncology.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

1. Oncology Foundation Model Development

* Design, train, and fine-tune large-scale multimodal foundation models specialized in oncology (e.g., integrating spatial transcriptomics, whole-slide images, and clinical histories).
* Implement pre-training strategies tailored to bio-medical domains, including self-supervised learning (SSL), contrastive learning, and masked token prediction.
* Evaluate model robustness, generalization, and domain shift across diverse patient cohorts, tumor types, and sequencing platforms.

2. Agentic Platform Engineering

* Architect scalable agentic frameworks (e.g., tool-use, multi-agent communication, autonomous planning, and retrieval-augmented generation) tailored for clinical workflows.
* Design safety guards, reasoning trace verification, and human-in-the-loop interventions for AI agents operating in high-stakes medical settings.
* Integrate agentic systems with external biological knowledge bases, literature databases (PubMed, clinical trials), and EHR interfaces.

3. Connecting Models & Agents (The Synergy)

* Expose specialized oncology foundation models as core tools/capabilities within the agentic platform, enabling agents to dynamically invoke multi-omic analysis tools.
* Develop agent-driven workflows that use foundation models to summarize complex patient trajectories, propose biomarker-driven treatment hypotheses, or query trial eligibility.
* Optimize end-to-end latency, reasoning chains, and output interpretability for clinical and scientific research end-users.

description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

**Homecare Homebase (HCHB)** is the software platform behind home health and hospice care across the United States, supporting scheduling, clinical documentation, coding, compliance and revenue cycle for agencies serving millions of patient visits each year.

We are seeking a **Principal AI Platform Engineer** to build our AI software factory. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write code every day, ship the first working version of our agent platform yourself, and then teach engineering teams to build on it. You will have no direct reports at the start. The platform will run agents against our production codebase, with people writing specifications and validating results and agents doing most of the implementation. You will also serve as the senior technical authority on AI built into our products.

Our primary stack is .NET and Azure, with Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure AI Foundry and MCP-based tooling, alongside other languages and frameworks. The agent platform must work across all of them. This is a greenfield effort, so you will set the standards rather than inherit them.

**Is This Role for You?**
-------------------------

This role is for someone who builds. You’ll set standards, shape how teams use AI and influence the roadmap, but you’ll do it through working code and reference implementations, not decks, review boards or org charts. If your recent work has mostly been leading teams, advising executives or designing solutions that others implement, this probably isn’t the right match. Expect to spend most of your time coding, especially in your first few months.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**AI Platform Architecture and Development**

* Design, write and operate the agent platform that runs autonomously against our production codebase, taking work from specification to pull request with human review.
* Implement agentic patterns, orchestration and tool integration for real-world engineering workflows.
* Make the platform effective across our full technology stack, not only one language or framework.
* Define the agent templates and shared framework that every team uses.
* Own the AI lifecycle from concept through deployment, operation and iteration on Azure and Azure AI Foundry.
* Shape how work is handed to agents and review the results, from concept to specification through pull request.

**Developer Experience and Integration**

* Partner with application teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing products and workflows.
* Build the APIs, SDKs, MCP servers and extension points that engineering teams build on.
* Establish how MCP servers, tools and agent skills are packaged, versioned, discovered and distributed to teams, such as through an internal registry or catalog with access controls.
* Design tool access with per-tenant data scoping, so that an agent acting for one agency can reach only that agency’s data.

**Context and Knowledge Engineering**

* Design the context, skills and retrieval patterns that make AI agents effective in large codebases, including an application-level knowledge map that tells an agent which module a ticket belongs to and what it affects.
* Decide when retrieval is the right tool and when curated context is better.
* Establish versioning, review and governance for shared AI assets.

**Evaluation, Safety and Operational Quality**

* Build evaluation frameworks that measure AI output quality and detect regressions.
* Define guardrails, failure handling and human-in-the-loop controls for regulated environments, including keeping PHI out of agent context, prompts and logs.
* Monitor and optimize AI systems for reliability, accuracy and cost efficiency, with token budgets, rate limits, retry caps and step limits.
* Establish observability best practices across supervised and autonomous AI usage.

**Enablement and Technical Leadership**

* Mentor engineers across the organization and raise AI engineering capability at scale, by building working examples in their own codebases.
* Define engineering standards and shape the AI technical roadmap with the CTO.

**Innovation and Applied Research**

* Evaluate emerging capabilities in LLMs, agentic AI, RAG and MCP, and bring what proves out into production.
* Advise on build, buy and partner decisions across the AI toolchain.
* Maintain a working view of commercial and open-weight models, and match model tiers to tasks by cost, latency, quality and data-handling terms.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Within your first 90 days, a working agent template and shared framework that engineering teams can adopt, with at least one team using it on real tickets.
* Telemetry in place for token spend, agent launch frequency and traceable tool calls.
* A baseline for measuring the impact on our development process: time saved, delivery velocity and cost.
* One common standard across teams such as clinical, revenue cycle and integration, so that each team owns its knowledge but no team builds its own agents, models or tiers.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years in software engineering, with recent hands-on coding. You write code today, not only review it.
* 3+ years building and operating production AI systems in which agents call tools or change code. RAG or machine learning products alone do not meet this bar.
* Proficiency in Python and modern AI tooling (for example LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs).
* Hands-on experience building MCP servers or equivalent tool interfaces, including authentication and per-tenant access control.
* Ability to make agents effective across multiple languages and technology stacks, not only one.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads in cloud environments (Azure preferred).
* Solid grasp of LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and context engineering.
* Proven RAG experience, and judgment on when retrieval beats curated context.
* Experience with AI evaluation and observability, including quality measurement, cost and token management.
* Working knowledge of handling regulated data such as PHI in AI systems.
* Demonstrated record of mentoring engineers and raising technical capability across teams.
* Evidence of your own work: a repository, code sample or demo of agent or MCP work that you personally built.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating AI into C# and .NET applications.
* Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code on large codebases.
* Familiarity with vector databases and retrieval tooling (for example pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search).
* Exposure to LLMOps and evaluation tooling (for example Azure AI Foundry, MLflow, LangSmith, CI/CD).
* Familiarity with agent-to-agent communication standards such as A2A, and judgment on when a multi-agent design is warranted over a single agent with tools.
* Experience with large legacy codebases and incremental modernization.
* Interest in healthcare, EHR or revenue cycle applications.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Sponsorship:** This position does not provide immigration sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------

**We don't just help our clients succeed; we help our employees succeed.** Competitive pay, robust benefits and professional development opportunities are a few of the many reasons Homecare Homebase is a great place to build your career.

* **Meaningful work.** Make a difference in the lives of clinicians and home-based care teams—and ultimately the patients they serve.
* **Leaders who care.** Work in a culture where leaders value, support and invest in their people.
* **Flexibility.** We value work-life balance and offer career opportunities designed to support life’s changing demands.
* **A company that gives back.** Each year, Homecare Homebase supports charitable initiatives that align with our mission of empowering exceptional care and helping others in need.

**Sound like a good fit? We’d love to hear from you.**
